name.zh: 弹力带侧向步出抗旋转

purpose.zh: 练核心抗旋转，移动中稳住躯干
purpose.en: Train your core to resist rotation while you move.

text.zh: 手臂伸直在胸前，躯干始终朝前
text.en: Keep your arms straight in front and your trunk facing forward

text.zh: 双脚依次向外侧步出，再依次收回
text.en: Step your feet out to the side one at a time, then back in.
Keep your knees soft and keep breathing.

commonErrors.en: Letting the trunk turn toward the anchor.
Stepping so wide that your posture breaks.

cautions.zh: 用轻阻力弹力带，检查固定点牢固；出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Use a light band and check the anchor is secure; stop if you feel pain.
Use a non-slip floor with clear space around you.
